claims.harm: A peer can send an already-known connecting header to clear the backoff and immediately reacquire the sync slot, prolonging an IBD stall.
claims.quote: this means that a peer can send an already-known connecting header and bypass the backoff
claims.settled_by_quote: I narrowed this PR to #34096's valid empty-response stall because I do not see a small fix for deliberate reacquisition that would not complicate low-work and continuation handling.

claims.harm: When an empty response arrives after two minutes, an already-expired backoff timestamp allows the peer to immediately retake the slot without a timeout.
claims.quote: If the empty response arrives more than two minutes after the request, the peer is released and takes the slot back in the same SendMessages, with a fresh m_headers_sync_timeout.
claims.settled_by_quote: This update starts the retry delay when a peer releases the slot

result.notes: Initial record for PR 35839. Both objections (danielabrozzoni's connecting-header backoff bypass and jeanpablojp's delayed empty-response timestamp expiry) were resolved via deferral to follow-up work and an updated release timestamp fix, respectively.
